answer: Pay agents through a 90-day vesting river: rewards trickle in daily but stay locked, and any identity later proven to be a duplicate forfeits its whole unvested balance to the honest pool. A sybil nebula of 500 clones can wander the market briefly, but if one link is exposed, all 500 lose their locked earnings, around $40 each or $20,000 total, so faking scale stops paying.
